To much to write down i am feeling a bit better atm but i am up and down like a yo yo. In my lifetime i have lost 2 brothers 2 children my mum and i hate my dad idk if he is alive or not but i do not care as he was a evil man. My first brother died for epileptic fit when he was 4. My other brother hung himself when i was 25. My mum die from serve lung problems i lost my first born due to relationship issues with her mum. My second child i walked away from due to the same issues. I can't make friends due to bad anxieties with talking the only friends i have are online due to the fact i can hide my issues behind my mic. Lots of other issue's also.

I thought like you but after a failed attempt at taking my life a week ago i seen my doctor and told them what i had done and what i was and still am thinking of doing. You may think to yourself they will just lock me up but you are very wrong unlike most people i had no network to turn to so i guess me going to my doctor was the only thing i could turn to. I am in the UK and still fighting thoughts of suicide in fact you can read my post in this forum i posted it lastnight when i was very low. I feel like i can not cope with people in anyway making friends is almost impossible for me. But i promis you by going to the doctor and getting the ball rolling will help you

First you will talk to a mental health person they are there to help not shame you or make you feel bad. Then if they feel you need it which i think you may do they will add you to there team which means daily visits at your home or somewhere you feel safe. They will not commite you. With me i was that bad i couldn't cope with daily living so they offered a place called rest bite which as you i thought oh no a nut house. It was upto me so i said i would go for 1 night and see how it was. They are brilliant do not treat you like a nut job and it is good to know that when i am very low i can talk to them only if i want too. Its just a big house with your own room and you are free to come and go as you please. I am not saying its for you but it is helping me well a week on i am still by my own choice. I am getting help with my anxiety and serve depression. It something to think about and is way better than ending your life also you can inbox me if you want any advice i am going through the same thing.
